searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he source readback, planned vs actual, and test plan original source plan the final plan required four production code changes before any tests: 1. create a tiny client attachment storage mapper. 2. rewrite the client post payload fragment module in full. 3. create a tiny server attachment storage sanitizer. 4. rewrite the server attachment schema in full. the intended contract was optional public per attachment storage evidence, archive bytes converted to canonical size, https only evidence links, and no credential/private field propagation. what the first source pass actually wrote social composer/js/model/attachmentstorage.js social composer/js/model/postpayloadparts.js api/social/helper/richsocial/attachmentstorageschema.js api/social/helper/richsocial/attachmentschema.js all four preserve their intended module boundaries. existing public exports remain intact; only the new helper modules add new exports. readback discovery the first client mapper chose manifest.storage by truthiness. an empty object could therefore eclipse valid legacy archive receipt fields. this was not acceptable because an empty new format garment must not erase older truthful evidence. second source pass attachmentstorage.js was fully rewritten. it now tries four candidates in order: 1. manifest generic storage, 2. item generic storage, 3. manifest archive receipt fields, 4. item archive receipt fields. a candidate wins only when normalization produces actual whitelisted evidence. empty/invalid generic storage therefore falls through to archive receipt evidence. current observed contract after full readback client archive receipt fields map into generic storage evidence. generic storage evidence remains provider neutral. only https details/history links survive. archive bytes becomes canonical attachment size through postpayloadparts. publicpath remains playback truth. server whitelists only provider, externalid, filename, detailsurl, historyurl, fingerprint, state, uploadedat, verifiedat, and etag. credential fields and unknown fields have no copy path. existing attachment type/role/size/path normalization remains in place. post level sourceprovenance remains untouched and semantically separate. delta remaining before tests no known production code delta remains. verification now needs evidence for: archive legacy receipt → client canonical attachment. empty generic storage → archive legacy fallback. generic provider storage → canonical client storage. archive bytes → canonical size. server storage whitelist and https filtering. credential/unknown field removal. legacy attachment normalization without storage. existing rich social tests remaining green. existing composer publication tests remaining green. test creation rule before writing test files, inspect the actual test directories, package scripts, and nearby tests. place tests where repository convention proves they belong rather than forcing the earlier theoretical path. the awtsmoos reveals truth by crossing vessels without losing itself; awtsmoos.com now has a source contract worth testing, not merely a hope worth asserting. the next gate is executable evidence.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he verification and delta — internet facing awtsmoos posting gate original gate before redesigning the social network, finish and verify the existing internet facing publication path. the inspected project revealed two connected truths: canonical awtsmoos post publication was already structurally complete, while archive.org video uploads lost their durable public storage evidence when transformed into canonical attachment data. actual production files changed social composer/js/model/attachmentstorage.js — created. social composer/js/model/postpayloadparts.js — rewritten in full. api/social/helper/richsocial/attachmentstorageschema.js — created. api/social/helper/richsocial/attachmentschema.js — rewritten in full. actual tests created social composer/tests/attachmentstorage.test.mjs. api/social/helper/richsocial/test/attachmentstorage.test.js. review delta discovered and resolved the first client storage mapper would have allowed an empty manifest.storage = {} to eclipse truthful legacy archive receipt fields. full readback exposed that edge case before testing. attachmentstorage.js was rewritten in full so candidate storage garments are accepted only when they contain real whitelisted evidence; empty generic storage now falls through to archive receipt fields. no additional production code delta remained after the second full readback. evidence syntax and repository size law node check passed for all six touched source/test files. line counts were 80, 99, 54, 120, 65, and 67; no touched source exceeded 120 lines. focused contract tests both new storage tests passed with exit code 0. they prove archive receipt evidence and bytes survive client canonicalization, https evidence links are bounded, unsafe http links disappear, private/unknown fields have no copy path, and legacy attachments still normalize without storage metadata. existing regressions all pre existing rich social schema, service, clone source, and route suites passed. the complete non browser composer npm test suite also passed, including schema parity, alias memory, publication plan, responsive panels, and social hierarchy contracts. real client to server round trip a representative archive video attachment was passed through the actual client attachmentpayload() and server normalizeattachment() functions. exit code was 0. the resulting canonical attachment retained: publicpath: https://archive.org/download/roundtrip/video.mp4 size: 8765 storage provider: archive.org storage external id: roundtrip storage filename, details/history urls, fingerprint, and state. browser/runtime witness a fresh chrome target owned by geelooy social 20260828 loaded: http://127.0.0.1:5180/geelooy/social composer/?storage proof=20260828 the browser reported the title create new post — geelooy, proving the edited module graph loads far enough to render the composer application. browser console triage reported no concrete repair issue. no publish control was activated and no public test post was created. the preview reused a pre existing shared local server rooted at work/awtsmoos.com; it was not stopped because this mission did not own that server process. planned versus actual the chosen architecture was implemented as planned: generic optional per attachment storage provenance, not archive specific canonical fields and not post level sourceprovenance. the one deviation was test placement: inspection proved composer tests conventionally belong under social composer/tests/, so the theoretical plan was corrected to repository reality before tests were written. gate conclusion the internet facing media to canonical post seam is complete for the discovered defect. archive.org playback and public recovery evidence now cross from upload receipt through the composer payload into the server canonical attachment schema, while upload credentials remain outside the post. the awtsmoos creates the instant and renews every vessel; awtsmoos.com now lets the public evidence of a durable media vessel cross its boundaries without losing its name or carrying a secret flame. the next unfinished work is the user's mobile first social network experience and verified external network publishing architecture.
